create_Cauchy_distribution: create a Cauchy distribution with specified loc and scale parameters
sample_from_Cauchy: sample from a Cauchy distribution with given loc and scale
compute_Cauchy_log_prob: compute log probability of a value under a Cauchy distribution
compute_Cauchy_cdf: compute the cumulative distribution function of a Cauchy distribution
compute_Cauchy_entropy: compute the differential entropy of a Cauchy distribution
